messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — proposing Q3/Q4 scope for Optimize toolkit: batching + prefix caching recommendations, regression gates, prompt-set ownership. Need launch criteria by EOD Friday.
Ben (Eng): +1. Can we narrow to 3 core features for launch? auto-batching config, KV-prefix cache, and rollout telemetry.
Sofia (ML): Suggest gating: quality regressions <2% delta on eval set A and latency delta <15% p95.
David (Design): Need a short UX flow for 'Apply recommendation' and 'Preview impact' — 2 small screens.
Maya (PM): Agree. Also add 'prompt-set steward' role. Who volunteers?
Ben (Eng): I'll own infra. Will need input on sample size for evals.
Sofia (ML): Recommend min 5k prompts for core recs, stratified by customer workload. Use holdout 10% for final validation.
Sam (SRE): For rollout backstop: auto-rollback if error rate + timeout rate both spike >1.5x within 5 min.
Maya (PM): Launch criteria checklist draft:
```
- Feature complete (3 recs)
- Eval pass: regression <2%
- Cost target: <= $0.80 per 1k tokens CPU-equivalent
- Internal beta with 2 customers
- Docs + SDK samples
```
Ben (Eng): Cost target seems tight, maybe $1.00/1k realistic. Can ops accept?
Maya (PM): ok, push to $1.0 if needed. We'll note in OKR as cost-per-token target.
David (Design): Also need copy for in-console warnings when users accept quantization recs.
Sofia (ML): On prompt sets: propose canonical names and owner tag in eval catalog. Example: "support-qa_v1" by @Sofia.
Maya (PM): Action items: Ben infra spec by Tue, Sofia eval plan + sample lists by Wed, David mockups by Thu. I'll prep roadmap slide.
qa-bot: Reminder set for due dates: Ben Tue, Sofia Wed, David Thu. :memo: 
Maya (PM): Thx — quick poll: do we keep auto-apply off by default? React with :thumbsup: = off; :eyes: = on for opt-in beta.
Ben (Eng): :thumbsup: 
Sofia (ML): :thumbsup: 
David (Design): :eyes: 
Maya (PM): Consensus = keep off by default. We'll run 2-customer beta for opt-in.
Sam (SRE): Noted on monitoring hooks. I'll add metrics to the rollout dashboard.
Maya (PM): Great—closing thread, I'll circulate a PRD Monday. Thanks team!
